03

OmniSeek

RETRIEVAL / MULTIMODAL AI

Semantic search across text, images, audio, video and code using EmbeddingGemma 2 and on-demand Modal GPUs. Results retain source files, code locations and timestamps. Existing indexes remain searchable on CPU.

EmbeddingGemma 2ModalFastAPIFAISSReact
Repository ↗API validation ↗
Recorded integration
5 modalities
One search experience

The API validation records real indexing, a new GPU query and a successful restart without GPU access.

Local, single-user application. New queries require inference; the demo includes precomputed embeddings.

04

Helix

EXECUTION / GPU ENGINEERING

A transformer inference kernel laboratory in CUDA C++ and Triton: softmax, GEMM, attention, RMSNorm and INT8 weight-only linear. Numerical correctness and latency are compared against native PyTorch implementations.

CUDA C++TritonPyTorchNVIDIA L4Modal
Repository ↗L4 experiment ↗
Initial L4 experiment
171
Validated comparisons

176 correctness tests: 152 GPU cases and 24 CPU/adapter cases, as recorded in the repository report.

Results depend on operator and shape. GEMM and attention do not outperform native baselines in the highlighted cases.

Also exploring / scientific computing

02 / Foundations

Mathematics informs
the engineering.

My foundations span optimization, probability, linear algebra and numerical stability. I'm currently pursuing a master's degree in artificial intelligence.

I care about how models learn, how their operations map to hardware and how their predictions behave within a larger system.

Read my GitHub profile ↗

∇Optimize the right objective

Connect the loss function, evaluation metric and operational goal. Understand the cost of being wrong.

ΣRespect the numerics

Treat precision, accumulation and tolerances as algorithmic choices. Check correctness before measuring speed.

ΔLook beyond the average

Investigate leakage, imbalance and distribution shift. Make model failure cases visible.

↻Build inspectable systems

Preserve versions, experimental conditions and results to explain what changed and how to recover.
